lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh Gemfile.lock weekly. This is what updates the fastlane plugins: they are declared without a version in fastlane/Pluginfile and only pinned in the lock file.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: weekly, grouped into one PR with the same commit prefix and labels Dependabot used
Leave runner labels and action version inputs alone, Dependabot never updated those

Our own actions that follow a branch (like home-assistant/actions@master) float on purpose. Pinning them would open a digest PR in every repository for each change to them. Our own actions on a version tag are pinned like any other.
